clips.original_text: 全てを見通す精霊の目を
clips.speaker: SPEAKER_00

all_attempts.translation: The spirit's eye sees it all.

clips.translated_text: The spirit's eye sees it all.
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG The spirit's eye sees it all.

clips.speaker: SPEAKER_03

all_attempts.translation: I’ll stick to the covenant of old.

clips.translated_text: I’ll stick to the covenant of old.
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG I’ll stick to the covenant of old.

clips.original_text: 我が友が君の先祖から受けた恩に報いるため
clips.speaker: SPEAKER_03

all_attempts.translation: To repay the kindness given by your ancestors to us,
To honor my friend’s debt to your ancestors,
To repay my friend’s debt to your ancestors,

clips.translated_text: To repay the kindness given by your ancestors to us,
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG To repay the kindness given by your ancestors to us,

clips.speaker: SPEAKER_03

all_attempts.translation: I'll lend you the power of the spirits.
Let's channel the spirits' power for you.
I shall grant you the power of spirits.

clips.translated_text: I shall grant you the power of spirits.
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG I shall grant you the power of spirits.

clips.speaker: UNKNOWN

all_attempts.translation: Come on, just say it already.
Just say it, come on already.

clips.text_with_emotion: ANG i can see it now,

clips.original_text: 家 待機を漂うマナに精霊のステータスや真の名前までが
clips.speaker: SPEAKER_01

all_attempts.translation: In the air, I can feel the mana waiting, even the spirits' true names.
I can sense the mana lingering here, even the spirits' true names and stats around me.
I can feel mana drifting here, even the spirits’ true names and their stats.

clips.translated_text: I can sense the mana lingering here, even the spirits' true names and stats around me.
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG I can sense the mana lingering here, even the spirits' true names and stats around me.

clips.original_text: ありがとうございました
clips.speaker: UNKNOWN

clips.original_text: 貴様らは死の大地まで
clips.speaker: SPEAKER_04

all_attempts.translation: You’re headed for the grave now.
You’ll meet your end right here.

clips.translated_text: You’ll meet your end right here.
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG You’ll meet your end right here.

clips.original_text: 最後に残った我らの安息の地まで奪おうとするのか
clips.speaker: SPEAKER_04

all_attempts.translation: Are you trying to take what’s left of our sanctuary?
You really want to steal our last safe haven?
So, you plan to take away our last refuge?

clips.translated_text: Are you trying to take what’s left of our sanctuary?
clips.text_with_emotion: ANG Are you trying to take what’s left of our sanctuary?

all_attempts.translation: This is the end for you!
